explication: Hugging Face Skills is a collection of installable, self-contained AI/ML workflow instructions and scripts for agents. The main user-to-result path is an agent selecting a task skill, following its instructions, and running its scripts or connecting to the relevant Hugging Face or cloud service. The sampled runtime includes SageMaker deployment modes, model-training and evaluation examples, paper management, and two dataset-backed leaderboard apps. Many README-listed skills have no implementation excerpts here, so their internal flows are not expanded.
